name: Zakopane
tagline: Poland's mountain town at the foot of the Tatras
summary: Zakopane is Poland's winter capital and the gateway to the High Tatras. Hike to the glacial lake of Morskie Oko, ride the cable car to Kasprowy Wierch on the Slovak border, browse the smoked cheese stalls on Krupówki street and admire the wooden Zakopane-style houses. Skiing in winter, hut-to-hut hiking in summer.
seasonNote: Summer for hiking, January to March for skiing; weekends are very busy.
arrival: Buses and trains from Kraków take about 2 to 2.5 hours.
gettingAround: Minibuses to trailheads; walk the town.
cashTip: Cards and phone payments work almost everywhere. Tip about 10 percent in restaurants.
foodTip: Oscypek smoked sheep cheese grilled with cranberry, kwaśnica sour cabbage soup and pierogi.
buyTip: Oscypek cheese and wool from the Gubałówka market.
